phase_contract.PERCEIVE: Consume real Scout repository state and identify a novel change, degradation, evidence ascent, or unresolved frontier.
phase_contract.CHOOSE: Select exactly one bounded task using a machine-readable deterministic policy and persist the rationale.
phase_contract.ACT: Create or resume one Git issue and one janus-life/* task branch in Janus-Demiurge, then commit one substantive verified frontier capsule under git_life/workbench/.
phase_contract.VERIFY: Run compile/self-test/path firewall plus artifact binding verification before calling the cycle PASS.
phase_contract.ADAPT: If attempt one fails verification, allow exactly one bounded corrective attempt; otherwise record BLOCKED and stop.
phase_contract.REMEMBER: Persist a create-only cycle receipt plus current life state on main, including evidence, rationale, branch head, attempts and result.
phase_contract.CONTINUE: Re-arm on the next completed Scout Swarm run, with a scheduled fallback, and require novel bounded evidence before another action.

bootstrap_evidence.adaptation: Preserve the global JSON ignore policy while explicitly versioning git_life/**/*.json as bounded evidence; exact cycle retry resumed issue 74 instead of creating a duplicate.

claim_ceiling: The first bounded autonomous Git life cycle is observed and receipt-grounded inside Janus-Demiurge. General autonomy, autonomous repair of arbitrary failures, a second natural continuation cycle, safe arbitrary code modification, independent scientific evidence, target-repository write authority, and commerce remain unproven or unauthorized.
